name: IDEC Corporation
summary: IDEC Corporation engages in the human-machine interface (HMI), industrial relays and components, automation and sensing, safety and explosion protection, and systems businesses in Japan, America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers HMI products comprising control switches, joysticks, indicator lights and buzzers, and programmable displays; industrial relays and components consisting of switching power supplies, terminal blocks, control relays and sockets, circuit protectors, relay socket timers, and LED lighting products.
